content.comment_body: Hello, I have a question. We are using a [product_name] [article_no] with Ethernet, and I'd like to control outputs via a basic HMI panel. Can a [product_name] panel communicate with a [product_name] [article_no]? I've already connected the [product_name] [article_no] to [product_name], so that's fine; however, before installing the panel in an electrical box, I want to be sure it communicates correctly over Ethernet.

Yes, that works very well. The [product_name] [article_no] connects via Ethernet to [product_name] HMI panels. In [product_name], you can select [product_name] for communication, or choose [version_no], since they use the same protocol. Good luck.

Hello, You should refer to the application examples for [product_name]. For HMI communication starting from [product_name] [version_no], the setup uses a [product_name] panel, but you can use a different model without issue. Note: For communication with a [product_name] [article_no], make sure to select the "[product_name]" communication driver. Regards, [user_name]
